result.title: Sep-Latent: Separator Tokens as Natural Compression Anchors for Implicit Reasoning
result.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but the associated computational overhead and token verbosity remain significant barriers to efficiency. While implicit reasoning in continuous latent spaces offers a promising alternative, existing methods like Coconut and CODI often rely on fixed-length latent sequences and suffer from representational collapse. In this paper, we propose Sep-Latent, an adaptive implicit reasoning framework that utilizes separator tokens as structural semantic anchors. By introducing an Attention-Decay mechanism, we force the model to aggregate and compress reasoning logic into these anchors during training. We then align explicit and implicit pathways through multi-level distillation across all layers to ensure logical consistency. Crucially, Sep-Latent enables dynamic reasoning depth by adaptively terminating the latent thinking phase based on query complexity. Experimental results on the GSM8k-Aug benchmark show that Sep-Latent achieves an accuracy of 56.8\% with an average of only 5.4 tokens, significantly outperforming prior fixed-length implicit models in efficiency while narrowing the performance gap with explicit CoT. Further analysis via PCA and symbolic variant testing confirms that our method ensures semantic grounding and exhibits superior robustness to perturbations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Sep-Latent：用 separator token 作语义锚点，通过 Attention-Decay 迫使模型把推理逻辑压缩进锚点，并以多层蒸馏对齐显式与隐式路径，实现按查询复杂度自适应终止隐式推理；在 GSM8k-Aug 上以平均 5.4 个 token 达到 56.8% 准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 latent reasoning，不直接研究视觉推理，但其「latent 阶段自适应终止」与层间蒸馏对齐可作为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与监督信号的核查线索；attention-decay 压缩锚点也可能与 latent 状态的信息坍缩问题相关。
